detaileddescription.para: Parse the snapshot and configure VART ML accordingly. snap_path is the path to the snapshot directory (in which there are snapshot.dump.* files). If snap_path is empty or NULL, npu_parse_snapshot uses setting snapshot.directory from vaisw.ini.

parameterdescription.para: Path of the snapshot files repository.
Pointer of pointer to the snapshot descriptor container created in the call.

simplesect.para: int The Vart ML error (vart_ml_error_id) code of the operation.

briefdescription.para: Free any memory allocated by npu_parse_snapshot, including snap.
